- No other problem's tool, no route, no aggregated chain, no ordered cross-problem step list, no wrong-vs-right contrast, no FAQ walking the chain anywhere in docs/service.
- Titles are general subjects (e.g. "Redeeming Owner Rewards Points Toward a Repair Order", "Points Held Back from Redemption: Returned Payments and Enrollment Bonus"); none mirrors this task's situation.
- Depended-on documents are reachable by the records' own words ("points-earned entry", "overage credit", "points-expired entry", "month-end").
- Factor documents state ladders as rules; none says which tier a customer falls on, none points at the computation document or another factor. Computation documents carry no "unless otherwise provided"/pointer language; their assembly sentences ("every rate / dollar amount / bonus rate / multiplier ... this policy sets out") are the source rule's own assembly sentences — recorded as policy-side note P-1 in `_difficulty.md`, not as a KB verdict.

**PASS.** No KB-EXPLICIT RED.
